# District 4 Elections

States of Jersey elections held in District 4 — St Helier North — since 2022:

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-4#deputies)**

* * *

* * *

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Inna Gardiner](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/inna-gardiner), [Mary Le Hegarat](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mary-le-hegarat), [Max Andrews](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/max-andrews) and [Stephen Ahier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stephen-ahier) were elected as Deputies of District 4 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Inna Gardiner](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/inna-gardiner)** |  | 1,665 | 70.9% |
| 2 | **[Mary Le Hegarat](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mary-le-hegarat)** |  | 1,268 | 54% |
| 3 | **[Max Andrews](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/max-andrews)** |  | 1,136 | 48.4% |
| 4 | **[Stephen Ahier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stephen-ahier)** |  | 999 | 42.5% |
| 5 | [Phil Romeril](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/phil-romeril) | Jersey Alliance | 737 | 31.4% |
| 6 | [Trevor Pointon](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/trevor-pointon) | Reform Jersey | 656 | 27.9% |
| 7 | [Ted Vibert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ted-vibert) | Jersey Alliance | 444 | 18.9% |

2,348 ballots (inc. 3 spoilt papers)

6,496 registered voters

36.1% turnout

* * *

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Stephen Ahier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stephen-ahier) : Current Deputy of District 4 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/10/st-helier-deputy-seeks-third-term-as-polling-day-moves-closer/)\]
- [Max Andrews](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/max-andrews) : Current Deputy of District 4 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/19/st-helier-deputy-to-seek-second-term/)\]
- [Ian Barnes](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-barnes) : New Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/16/former-chamber-president-to-stand-in-election/)\]
- [Victoria Li](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/victoria-li) : New Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/10/entrepreneur-standing-for-election-to-get-things-done/)\]
- [Kevin O'Connell](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-oconnell) : New Candidate (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/21/healthcare-on-agenda-for-st-helier-north-and-reform-jersey-candidate/)\]
- [Gerald Voisin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerald-voisin) : Previous States Member \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/20/retail-head-to-seek-states-return-after-more-than-two-decades/)\]
